recommendedUserFlow: extract approved complete portable bundle to a local user-writable directory
review and approve the displayed new-private-instance scope; then wait for verified readiness

fixedScope.administrativeIdentity: vendor-created root@localhost, only for this new private instance; never a Web or Runner identity

requiredApprovals.scope: exact official Windows Java21/MySQL8.4 artifacts, versions, source URLs, digests, license and native-runtime requirements; no auto latest or unverified bundling
a user-selected Windows host and concrete local private instance/data/log/TLS/secret-store paths; no guessed machine
initialize only a proven absent/empty owned private datadir; create these two schemas and three scoped accounts; rotate this instance initial root password
cryptographic credentials/TLS/trust generation, current-user protected storage, foreground owned processes and loopback-only ports; no system services or PATH/firewall changes

hardPreconditions: No binary runs in this preparation batch; no executor is included.
Official artifact hashes and exact versions must be verified before any future execution.
VC++/UCRT availability for the chosen Windows MySQL ZIP is not proven; do not copy System32 DLLs or install a redistributable without separate approval.
The parent instance directory is local, non-symlink and owner-private; ACL semantics must be verified on Windows.
Datadir and instance marker must not belong to any pre-existing service or contain existing data; no IF NOT EXISTS adoption.
A held per-instance lock and durable phase journal fence concurrent initialization and unknown results.
Port occupancy is not ownership; another listener is never reused or stopped.
Windows current-user secret protection must work before persisting secrets; no plaintext fallback.
All template tokens are validated and rendered only by an approved coordinator; SQL is never a user manual step.

Secure initialization uses initialize.ini.template without references to future TLS files; normal/bootstrap my.ini is read only after the TLS material existence and ownership gate. Automatic vendor TLS material generation is not claimed verified.

rendering.passwordPolicy: Future generated secrets use a cryptographic source and a validated safe alphabet; serialize complete SQL literals, never raw text. No secrets are generated in this plan.
rendering.pathPolicy: Future paths must be explicit local absolute paths; normalize MySQL option paths to forward slashes; reject symlink/UNC, NUL/newlines, option injection and scope escape.

actions.description: Inspect verified dependency manifests, local host capability, free loopback ports, target ownership and absence without creating directories.

After explicit scope approval only, create new private directories and phase journal; prepare MySQL options, cryptographic secrets and protected storage. Never modify an existing shared directory or generated old config.

Run vendor secure initialization only once with a separate minimal non-listening config, never the normal TLS config. Capture the generated temporary expired root password solely in owner-private initialization log/working memory.
actions.onUnknown: freeze; inspect original PID/files/journal; never repeat --initialize, clear data or infer rollback

actions.description: Verify vendor initialization produced usable private ca.pem/server-cert.pem/server-key.pem. If absent or incompatible stop; never disable TLS.
Start the exact new private instance without TCP networking, with authenticated Windows shared-memory transport. No unauthenticated initialization mode.
actions.onUnknown: retain original ownership and evidence; do not start another server

actions.description: Use the vendor-created localhost administrative identity only in this private instance. Rotate its expired temporary password before CREATE/GRANT; feed approved SQL through stdin, with no client --force.
actions.secretTransport: owner-private client option file and stdin only; not argv, MYSQL_PWD, public logs or source
actions.onUnknown: freeze and inspect exact account/schema state under this original instance; never rerun CREATE/GRANT blindly or adopt IF NOT EXISTS

actions.description: Import this instance CA into a new private PKCS12 store using the portable approved JDK21 keytool. Never download a trust store or expose store password in argv.
Request authenticated shutdown over the original private memory transport, then confirm the original PID/start identity exited. No force kill.
actions.onUnknown: retain ownership and occupied instance; do not start replacement

actions.description: Start only after bootstrap exit is confirmed. Normal options disable shared memory/named pipes/MySQLX, bind IPv4 loopback, require verified TLS and preserve durable logs.
Verify TLS/server identity, exact schemas, runtime cross-schema/DDL denial, migration no global/grant rights; execute existing platform V1-V7 and Runner V1 with separate migration credentials.
actions.onUnknown: freeze incomplete migration state; no clean, repair or DDL rollback assumption

actions.description: Give the Web process only platform DML configuration. Confirm precise histories, actual private readiness and usable synthetic UI before claiming ready; real identity is a later phase.

credentials.atRestRequired: Windows current-user protected storage (for example DPAPI) plus owner-private ACL; adapter/inheritance behavior still needs approved Windows validation
credentials.adminReceives: only the short-lived approved private bootstrap/maintenance coordinator
credentials.plaintextTemporaryFiles: only newly created owner-private option/password files; remove only those files after protected-store verification, never shared or pre-existing files

recoveryRules: Do not delete or empty an existing datadir, instance journal, SQL history, backup or unknown occupancy.
Failed/unknown initialization is not rollback; preserve original server ownership and inspect before any continuation.
Backup must cover both schemas, files and protected secret references; DPAPI recovery may depend on the original Windows user/profile/machine.
No upgrade/restore/re-provision action is executed in this preparation batch; RPO/RTO and recovery target remain explicit future acceptance gates.
notVerified: official Windows binary availability/digests and native VC++ runtime prerequisites
actual Windows shared-memory ACL/authentication and expired-root rotation
automatic TLS artifact generation and keytool import on chosen Windows binaries
current-user protected secret store and restoration on selected Windows host
new-instance original cold migration chain and actual privilege refusals
real Windows first install, startup/shutdown and nondeveloper usability
